automation.title: SIS Consultorios — Digital Secretary & Medical Software
automation.intro: SIS Consultorios is an autonomous SaaS platform engineered for private medical practices and clinics. Delivered 100% under your white-label brand, eliminating administrative overhead so healthcare professionals focus solely on patient care.

items.title: Frictionless 24/7 booking
items.desc: Patients schedule appointments in seconds from any browser without complex passwords or app installations.

items.title: Smart waitlists & auto confirmations
items.desc: 1-tap attendance reminders and automated slot reassignments in under 3 minutes to prevent lost revenue from cancellations.

items.title: Autonomous arrival check-in
items.desc: Patients tap «I have arrived» on their phone, smoothly advancing the virtual waiting room.

items.title: 1-tap prescriptions & lab orders
items.desc: Instant PDF generation with certified digital signature for prescriptions and diagnostic test requisitions.

items.title: Direct payouts with 0% middleman fees
items.desc: 100% of patient payments go directly to your designated bank account without revenue splits.

items.title: Private practices
items.desc: Specialist physicians, psychologists, physiotherapists, and independent doctors seeking operational autonomy.

items.title: Dental and specialty clinics
items.desc: Multi-calendar and multi-office management delivering a cohesive patient journey.

items.title: 100% White-Label
items.desc: Patients interact solely with your brand, logo, and identity — zero third-party branding.

items.title: Rapid deployment
items.desc: Guided onboarding and dedicated setup to start booking appointments in days.
